text.en:
The following essential commodity shall not
be sold at more than the maximum selling prices for im-
porters, wholesalers and retailers set opposite each:
FOODSTUFF (IMPORTED)
Without I7 per cent Special Excise Tax on Foreign Exchange
Pillsbury's Best Enriched
Pillsbury's Best Enriched
... 10/5#
11.24
12.26
1,38
Pillsbury's Best Enriched
... 25/2#
12.60
13.75
0.62

The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include
the 7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect three days after the
date hereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of March, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three;
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
